# Original C0 evidence fixtures

These four small files were generated for C0 tests. Their text contains only
synthetic inventory/project evidence and Unicode examples. The JSON manifest
records expected extraction. PDF and DOCX were generated with the pinned
pypdf/python-docx libraries. They contain no operator data or credentials.

Fixtures belong only in Git/test environments and never in runtime images.
